title: Unsloth December Update
summary: Thanks for all the support this year!
body_markdown:
# Unsloth December Update


[Unsloth AI](https://substack.com/@unsloth)


Dec 18, 2025


Thanks for all the support this year! 🥰 In the past few weeks, we’ve got lots of Unsloth improvements and new models (from Google, NVIDIA, Mistral, and more). See below for the latest updates:


### ✨ New Google model


Google releases


**FunctionGemma** , a new


**270M** parameter model built for tool/function-calling. You can fine-tune it with Unsloth & later run/deploy on your phone. Learn how with our guide.


Our notebook turns FunctionGemma into a reasoning model by making it ‘think’ before tool-calling.


[FunctionGemma Guide](https://docs.unsloth.ai/models/functiongemma)


### 🦥 3× Faster Training


You can now train


**3× faster** and use


**~30% less VRAM** (with no accuracy loss) via new RoPE + MLP Triton kernels, padding-free training, and uncontaminated packing. Train Qwen3-4B 3× faster on just


**3.9GB VRAM** .


[3x Faster Blog](https://docs.unsloth.ai/new/3x-faster-training-packing)


---


We also added a preliminary


**multi-GPU support** :


[DDP Guide](https://docs.unsloth.ai/basics/multi-gpu-training-with-unsloth/ddp)
This is an early preview (the official release is expected early next year).


**🤗Transformers v5** is now supported, too!


---


### 📱 Deploy LLMs on your phone


We collaborated with PyTorch to enable you to fine-tune LLMs, and then directly deploy/run them on your phone.


**[Read guide](https://docs.unsloth.ai/new/deploy-llms-phone)**


### 🧠 500K context training


You can now do 500K context-length fine-tuning with Unsloth! Train gpt-oss-20B to extend its context window to 530K on 80GB VRAM and 750K+ on 192GB, with no accuracy loss.


Unsloth’s new algorithms + our collaboration with Snowflake enable ~72% less VRAM and up to


**6×** longer context lengths.


**[Read the blog](https://docs.unsloth.ai/new/500k-context-length-fine-tuning)**


### 💚 NVIDIA Nemotron 3


NVIDIA releases


**Nemotron 3** , a new


**30B** hybrid reasoning model. You can now fine-tune and run the model locally with Unsloth.


**[Nemotron 3 Guide](https://docs.unsloth.ai/models/nemotron-3)**


Also thanks to NVIDIA for collabing on a blogpost and video on how to do reinforcement learning (RL) with Unsloth:


**[NVIDIA blog](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/rtx-ai-garage-fine-tuning-unsloth-dgx-spark/)** •


**[Video Tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9t-BAjzBWj8)**


### 🐱 New Mistral models


Mistral releases Devstral 2 and Mistral 3, new multimodal models that excel at coding + chat workflows:


**[Ministral 3](https://docs.unsloth.ai/models/ministral-3)** •


**[Devstral 2](https://docs.unsloth.ai/models/devstral-2)**


You can fine-tune them all with Unsloth and we made a new reinforcement learning notebook for autonomously solving sudoku.


---


And that’s it, hope you have a wonderful Christmas and happy holidays! 🎁
